ticket: My card was charged twice for the same transaction
response: Your duplicate charge has been noted. Double charges are usually reversed automatically within 3-5 business days. If it does not reverse, contact your bank to file a dispute with the transaction reference number.

ticket: I think my card was used fraudulently without my permission
response: We have escalated your case to our fraud team as a high priority. Please call the number on the back of your card immediately to block it and report the unauthorized usage. Visa's Zero Liability Policy protects you from fraudulent charges.

ticket: Refund not received after cancelling my payment
response: Refunds on Visa transactions typically take 5-10 business days to appear after the merchant processes the return. If it has been longer, contact the merchant first, then your bank with the refund reference.

ticket: My Visa card was declined at the store
response: Card declines can happen due to an incorrect PIN, expired card, or a temporary block by your bank. Try again with the correct PIN, or contact your bank to check if the card is active and has no restrictions.

ticket: Someone made purchases on my card that I did not authorize
response: This has been flagged as a high-priority fraud case. Call your bank immediately to block the card and dispute all unauthorized transactions. Under Visa's Zero Liability Policy you are not responsible for unauthorized charges reported promptly.

ticket: I was overcharged by a merchant on my Visa card
response: Please contact the merchant first to request a correction. If they do not resolve it within 7 days, file a dispute with your bank under the billing error category. We have also flagged this for follow-up.

ticket: My Visa card expired and I need a replacement
response: Contact your bank to request a replacement card. Most banks automatically issue a new card before expiry — check if one is already in transit. Replacement cards typically arrive within 5-10 business days.

ticket: I cannot find my Visa card — I think it is lost
response: Report your card as lost to your bank immediately so it can be blocked. A replacement card will be issued within 5-10 business days. Monitor your recent transactions and dispute any unfamiliar charges.

ticket: My Visa card was stolen
response: This is a high-priority case. Contact your bank immediately to block the card and report it stolen. File a police report and share the reference with your bank. All unauthorized transactions will be covered under Visa Zero Liability.

ticket: How do I dispute a transaction on my Visa card
response: Log in to your bank's app or website, go to your transaction history, and select the transaction to dispute. Alternatively, call your bank's customer service. Disputes must typically be filed within 60-120 days of the statement date.

ticket: My bank says the refund was processed but I still do not see it
response: Refunds can take 1-3 extra business days to reflect after the bank processes them. Check with both the merchant and your bank using the refund reference number. If it still does not appear, escalate with your bank.

ticket: I was charged for a subscription I already cancelled
response: Contact the subscription service with your cancellation confirmation. If they do not refund within 7 days, file a billing dispute with your bank. We have flagged this for further review on our end.

ticket: What is the Visa Zero Liability Policy
response: Visa's Zero Liability Policy means you are not responsible for unauthorized transactions made on your card, as long as you report them promptly. Contact your bank as soon as you notice any suspicious charges.

ticket: My card was compromised in a data breach
response: This has been escalated as a high-priority security case. Your bank will likely proactively send you a replacement card. Monitor all recent transactions and dispute any unauthorized charges immediately.

ticket: How long does a chargeback take to resolve
response: Chargeback investigations typically take 30-90 days depending on the complexity and the merchant's response. Your bank will notify you of the outcome. Keep all documentation related to the transaction.

ticket: I see a small unfamiliar charge on my statement
response: Small unfamiliar charges are often subscription verification charges. Check your active subscriptions first. If you cannot identify the charge, contact your bank to dispute it and block future charges from that merchant.

ticket: My international transaction was declined
response: International transactions can be declined if your bank has not enabled them for your card. Contact your bank to enable international usage before travelling. Also inform them of your travel dates to prevent fraud blocks.

ticket: I was charged a foreign transaction fee I was not aware of
response: Foreign transaction fees are outlined in your card agreement — typically 1-3% per transaction. Review your card terms to verify. If the fee was applied incorrectly, contact your bank with the transaction details to dispute it.

ticket: How do I enable international transactions on my Visa card
response: Log in to your bank's app and go to Card Settings to enable international usage. Alternatively, call your bank's customer service. It is also advisable to inform your bank of your travel dates to prevent automatic fraud blocks.

ticket: My Visa card payment went through but the merchant says they did not receive it
response: This can happen due to a processing delay. Share the payment confirmation and transaction ID with the merchant. If they still cannot locate it after 3 business days, contact your bank to trace the payment.

ticket: Can I get a virtual Visa card for online purchases
response: Many banks offer virtual card numbers for online purchases through their app or website. Contact your bank to check if this feature is available. Virtual cards add an extra layer of security for online transactions.

ticket: My Visa card was blocked by my bank without any notice
response: Banks can temporarily block cards if they detect unusual activity. Contact your bank to verify your identity and request the block to be removed. They will confirm recent transactions and lift the block once verified.

ticket: I want to cancel a transaction I just made
response: Contact the merchant immediately to request a cancellation before the payment settles. Once settled, you will need to request a refund from the merchant or file a dispute with your bank if the merchant refuses.

ticket: My Visa prepaid card balance is incorrect
response: Log in to your prepaid card account to check your transaction history for any unexpected deductions. If the balance is still incorrect, contact the prepaid card issuer with your card details and a description of the discrepancy.

ticket: How do I set a spending limit on my Visa card
response: Spending limits can be set through your bank's mobile app under Card Settings. Some banks allow daily, weekly, or per-transaction limits. Contact your bank if the option is not visible in the app.

ticket: I received a Visa card I did not apply for
response: This could indicate identity theft. Do not activate the card. Contact the issuing bank immediately and report that you did not apply for this card. Also place a fraud alert with the credit bureaus.

ticket: My Visa card PIN is blocked after too many wrong attempts
response: A blocked PIN can be unblocked at your bank's ATM using your card and a new PIN, or by visiting a branch. Do not attempt more wrong PINs as this may lock the card entirely.

ticket: I was charged in the wrong currency for an online purchase
response: This may be due to the merchant's dynamic currency conversion. You can dispute the exchange rate with your bank if you were not clearly offered a choice of currency at checkout.

ticket: Merchant is refusing to refund my Visa card payment
response: If the merchant is refusing a legitimate refund, contact your bank to initiate a chargeback. Provide transaction proof, your refund request evidence, and the merchant's refusal. Chargebacks can be filed within 60-120 days of the transaction.

ticket: I accidentally sent money to the wrong account using my Visa card
response: Contact your bank immediately and report the mistaken transfer with the transaction details. Banks can sometimes recover funds if the recipient's bank cooperates. The sooner you report it, the better the chances of recovery.

ticket: My Visa card payment is pending for more than 5 days
response: Pending transactions usually settle within 1-5 business days. If it has exceeded this, contact your bank with the transaction ID to check the status and request it be released or settled.

ticket: I want to know my Visa card credit limit
response: Your credit limit is shown in your bank's mobile app under Account Details or Card Information. You can also call your bank's customer service to confirm your current limit and available credit.

ticket: How do I report a Visa card skimming incident
response: This is a high-priority fraud case. Block your card immediately by calling your bank. Report the skimming incident to the bank and local authorities. Your bank will issue a replacement card and investigate unauthorized transactions.

ticket: My Visa contactless payment is not working
response: Ensure contactless is enabled in your bank's app under Card Settings. Try tapping the card closer to the terminal reader. If it still fails, use the chip or swipe method and contact your bank to check contactless settings.

ticket: I want to increase my Visa card credit limit
response: Contact your bank to request a credit limit increase. They will review your credit history and income. You can submit the request through the bank's app, website, or customer service.

ticket: Why was my Visa card charged a maintenance fee
response: Maintenance or annual fees are specified in your card agreement. Review your terms to verify the fee is correct. If it was charged incorrectly or you were not informed, contact your bank to dispute it.

ticket: My Visa transaction is showing as failed but money was deducted
response: Failed transactions where money was deducted are usually auto-reversed within 3-7 business days. Contact your bank with the transaction ID if it does not reverse. We have also escalated this for review.

ticket: I cannot use my Visa card for online payments
response: Online payments may be blocked if 3D Secure is not set up or if your bank requires OTP verification. Enable online transactions in your bank's app and ensure your registered mobile number is active for OTP.

ticket: My Visa reward points are missing
response: Reward points usually take 2-7 business days to credit after a transaction. Log in to your rewards portal to check. If points are still missing, contact your bank with the transaction details.

ticket: How do I activate my new Visa card
response: Activate your new Visa card through your bank's mobile app under Card Management, or by making a chip-and-PIN transaction at an ATM or store. Some banks also allow activation by calling customer service.

ticket: I want to temporarily block my Visa card
response: You can temporarily block your Visa card through your bank's mobile app under Card Settings — look for Freeze Card or Lock Card. This prevents all new transactions while keeping the card active for future use.

ticket: My Visa card statement has an error
response: Download your statement from your bank's app and compare each transaction. For any incorrect entries, raise a dispute with your bank directly. Keep supporting documents like receipts or screenshots ready.

ticket: Why was I charged twice for an online subscription
response: Double charges on subscriptions can happen due to a payment processing error. Contact the subscription service first. If unresolved in 7 days, file a billing dispute with your bank for the duplicate charge.

ticket: I want to close my Visa card account
response: Contact your bank to request account closure. Ensure all outstanding balances are cleared and any automatic payments are updated to a different card before closing. Confirm the closure in writing.

ticket: My Visa card was used at a location I have never been to
response: This indicates possible fraudulent use. Block your card immediately through your bank's app or by calling customer service. Dispute the unauthorized transactions under Visa Zero Liability protection.

ticket: I did not receive my Visa card after applying
response: Visa cards typically take 7-14 business days to arrive after application approval. Check your application status in your bank's app. If it has been over 14 days, contact your bank to reissue the card.

ticket: Can I use my Visa card at an ATM abroad
response: Yes, Visa cards are accepted at most international ATMs. Inform your bank of your travel plans to prevent blocks. Note that international ATM withdrawals may incur a foreign transaction fee and currency conversion charges.

ticket: I was charged interest on my Visa card even though I paid in full
response: Interest can sometimes be charged due to a residual balance from the previous cycle. Check your statement carefully. If you believe it was charged in error, contact your bank with your payment confirmation.

ticket: My Visa card was not accepted at a specific store
response: Some merchants do not accept certain card types or networks. Confirm the store accepts Visa. If they do and your card is still declined, contact your bank to ensure there are no restrictions on the card.

ticket: How do I dispute an ATM withdrawal I did not make
response: This is a high-priority fraud case. Report the unauthorized ATM withdrawal to your bank immediately. They will investigate the transaction, check CCTV records if needed, and reverse the amount if fraud is confirmed.

ticket: I want to add my Visa card to Google Pay
response: Open Google Pay, go to Payment Methods, and tap Add a Card. Enter your Visa card details or scan the card. Your bank may send an OTP for verification. Once verified, the card will be ready for contactless payments.

ticket: My Visa card was charged for a service I never received
response: Contact the merchant to request a refund for the undelivered service. If they refuse, file a chargeback with your bank providing proof that the service was not delivered. We have flagged this for escalation.

ticket: Why is my Visa card showing available balance lower than expected
response: Pending authorizations from recent transactions can temporarily reduce your available balance. These holds are released once the transaction settles or the merchant cancels the authorization, usually within 3-7 days.

ticket: I want to dispute a hotel charge on my Visa card
response: Contact the hotel first to resolve any billing discrepancy. If they do not cooperate, file a chargeback with your bank. Provide your booking confirmation, check-in/check-out dates, and the disputed charge details.

ticket: I received a phishing email asking for my Visa card details
response: Do not click any links or share any details. Report the email to your bank and to the Anti-Phishing Working Group at reportphishing@apwg.org. If you already shared details, block your card immediately.

ticket: I was charged a late payment fee on my Visa card
response: Late fees are charged when payment is not received by the due date. If you believe you paid on time, contact your bank with your payment confirmation. You can also request a one-time waiver if this is your first late payment.

ticket: How do I check my Visa card transaction history
response: Log in to your bank's mobile app or internet banking portal to view your transaction history. You can usually filter by date, amount, or merchant. Monthly statements are also available for download.

ticket: My Visa card payment did not go through on an e-commerce site
response: Online payment failures can be caused by incorrect card details, a bank block on online transactions, or 3D Secure issues. Verify your card details, check if online payments are enabled in your bank's app, and retry.

ticket: I want to know the status of my Visa chargeback
response: Chargeback investigations take 30-90 days. Contact your bank with your chargeback reference number to get a status update. The bank will notify you of the final outcome once the investigation is complete.

ticket: My Visa card was used for a transaction in another country without my knowledge
response: This is a high-priority international fraud case. Block your card immediately and file a fraud report with your bank. All unauthorized international transactions are covered under Visa Zero Liability if reported promptly.

ticket: How do I set up autopay for my Visa credit card
response: Set up autopay through your bank's mobile app under Bill Pay or Auto Payment. You can choose to pay the minimum due, the statement balance, or a fixed amount each month. Ensure your linked bank account has sufficient funds.

ticket: My Amazon order has not arrived yet
response: Track your order under Your Orders → Track Package. If the estimated delivery date has passed, select Problem with order → Package didn't arrive to report it. Amazon will investigate and arrange a replacement or refund.

ticket: I received the wrong item from Amazon
response: Go to Your Orders → Return or Replace Items → Wrong item was sent. Amazon will arrange a return pickup and send the correct item or process a refund within 3-5 business days.

ticket: My Amazon package is marked as delivered but I did not receive it
response: Wait 48 hours as packages can sometimes be delivered slightly late. If still missing, go to Your Orders → Problem with Order → Package didn't arrive. Amazon will investigate and offer a refund or replacement.

ticket: I was charged twice for the same Amazon order
response: Go to Your Account → Payment Settings → View Transactions to verify the duplicate charge. Contact Amazon support with both transaction IDs. Duplicate charges are usually resolved within 3-5 business days.

ticket: I want to return an item I bought on Amazon
response: Go to Your Orders → Return or Replace Items within 30 days of delivery. Select your return reason, print the label, and drop it at the nearest courier pickup point. Refunds are processed within 3-5 days of return receipt.

ticket: My Amazon refund has not been received
response: Refunds take 3-5 business days after Amazon processes them. Check Your Orders → Refund Status to confirm it was processed. If the refund date has passed, contact Amazon support with your order ID.

ticket: The Amazon seller sent me a fake product
response: This is a serious issue. Report the seller under the product listing → Report an issue → This product is counterfeit. File an A-to-Z Guarantee claim for a full refund. We have escalated this case for priority review.

ticket: My Amazon Prime membership was charged without my consent
response: Check your Prime membership status under Your Account → Prime Membership. If it was auto-renewed unexpectedly, contact Amazon support to request a refund within 3 days of the charge. We have flagged this for escalation.

ticket: How do I cancel my Amazon Prime subscription
response: Go to Your Account → Prime Membership → End Membership and Benefits. Follow the prompts to cancel. Your Prime benefits continue until the end of the current billing period.

ticket: I want to know the status of my Amazon order
response: Go to Your Orders in the Amazon app or website. Click on the order to see real-time tracking information including the carrier name, tracking number, and estimated delivery date.

ticket: My Amazon order was cancelled automatically
response: Automatic cancellations can occur if payment fails or the item is out of stock. Check your payment method and retry, or search for the item again. Any charge for a cancelled order is refunded within 3-5 business days.

ticket: The Amazon item I received is damaged
response: Report the damaged item under Your Orders → Problem with Order → Item arrived damaged. Amazon will arrange a free replacement or full refund. You may be asked to return the damaged item.

ticket: I cannot log in to my Amazon account
response: Try resetting your password via the Forgot Password link on the login page. If you suspect unauthorized access, contact Amazon support immediately to secure your account.

ticket: My Amazon account was hacked
response: This is a high-priority security case. Change your password immediately at amazon.com/a/settings/approval. Review all recent orders and report any unauthorized purchases. We have escalated this for immediate review.

ticket: I ordered from Amazon but the seller is not responding
response: If the seller is unresponsive after 2 business days, you can open an A-to-Z Guarantee claim through Your Orders → Problem with Order. This protects your purchase and allows Amazon to step in for resolution.

ticket: How do I track my Amazon return shipment
response: After initiating a return, go to Your Orders → Return Status to see the return tracking details. You can also track it using the carrier's tracking number provided at the time of the return label generation.

ticket: My Amazon gift card balance is missing
response: Go to Your Account → Gift Cards to check your balance. If it is missing, contact Amazon support with the gift card code and proof of purchase. We have flagged this for review.

ticket: I placed a duplicate Amazon order by mistake
response: Cancel the duplicate order immediately by going to Your Orders → Cancel Items. If the order has already shipped, initiate a return upon delivery for a full refund.

ticket: Amazon delivered my order to the wrong address
response: Contact Amazon support immediately under Your Orders → Problem with Order → Shipped to wrong address. Amazon will investigate and arrange a replacement or refund. We have escalated this case.

ticket: I want to know Amazon's return policy
response: Most Amazon items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Some categories like electronics may have a 15-day window. Go to Your Orders → Return or Replace Items to initiate a return.

ticket: My Amazon subscribe and save order did not arrive
response: Check your Subscribe and Save order status under Your Account → Subscribe and Save. If the delivery is delayed, contact Amazon support with the subscription order ID for a replacement or refund.

ticket: I was scammed by an Amazon third-party seller
response: This is a high-priority fraud case. Report the seller via the product listing and file an A-to-Z Guarantee claim immediately. Amazon's guarantee covers purchases from third-party sellers. We have escalated this for urgent review.

ticket: How do I change my delivery address on Amazon
response: You can change your delivery address before the order ships by going to Your Orders → Change delivery instructions. If the order has already shipped, contact Amazon support — address changes may not always be possible.

ticket: Amazon charged me but the order was never placed
response: Check Your Orders to confirm if an order exists. If not, this could be an authorization hold that will release in 3-7 days. Contact Amazon support with the transaction ID if the charge does not reverse.

ticket: My Amazon Prime Video is not playing
response: Try clearing the app cache or reinstalling the Amazon Prime Video app. Check your internet speed — at least 5 Mbps is needed for HD streaming. Sign out and back in to refresh your subscription status.

ticket: I want to delete my Amazon account
response: Go to amazon.com/privacycentral to submit an account deletion request. Note that all your order history, reviews, and saved data will be permanently deleted. Outstanding orders should be completed before deletion.

ticket: I received a defective electronic item from Amazon
response: Report the defective item under Your Orders → Return or Replace Items → Item is defective within 15-30 days. Amazon will arrange a replacement or refund. Electronics may be subject to a shorter return window.

ticket: How do I contact Amazon customer service
response: Go to amazon.com → Help → Contact Us. You can choose to chat live, request a callback, or send an email. Have your order ID ready for faster resolution.

ticket: My Amazon Kindle book purchase is not showing in my library
response: Go to Your Account → Content and Devices → Books to find your purchase. If it is missing, try syncing your Kindle. If still not found, contact Amazon with your order ID to have the book re-delivered to your device.

ticket: Amazon applied the wrong coupon to my order
response: If the wrong coupon was applied, contact Amazon support immediately before the order ships. Once shipped, you can request a price adjustment. Provide the correct coupon code and your order ID.

ticket: My Amazon order shows out for delivery but has not arrived
response: Out for delivery updates can sometimes precede the actual delivery by several hours. Wait until end of day. If still not delivered, go to Your Orders → Problem with Order → Package did not arrive.

ticket: I want to dispute an Amazon charge on my credit card
response: Contact Amazon support first to resolve the billing issue. If unresolved, you can file a dispute with your bank. However, filing an A-to-Z Guarantee claim with Amazon is usually faster and does not require bank involvement.

ticket: My Amazon order is stuck in transit
response: Delays in transit can occur due to weather or logistics issues. Track your package using the carrier tracking number. If the package has not moved in 5+ business days, contact Amazon to initiate a trace or replacement.

ticket: I was sent an incomplete Amazon order
response: Report the incomplete delivery under Your Orders → Problem with Order → Missing items. Amazon will arrange delivery of the missing items or a partial refund for the items not received.

ticket: How do I leave a review on Amazon
response: Go to Your Orders → Write a Product Review next to the item. You can rate the product, add a written review, and upload photos. Reviews help other customers make better purchase decisions.

ticket: Amazon is showing an incorrect price for an item I already ordered
response: Amazon's prices can change frequently. Once an order is placed, the price at checkout is final. If you believe there is a pricing error, contact Amazon support for a price adjustment review.

ticket: My Amazon account is locked
response: Account locks can occur due to unusual activity or a security flag. Contact Amazon support to verify your identity and unlock the account. Have your registered email, phone number, and recent order details ready.

ticket: I want to know if my Amazon order is eligible for free delivery
response: Free delivery eligibility depends on your Prime membership, order total, and item type. Check the delivery details on the product page or in Your Cart before placing the order.

ticket: I received an Amazon package that is not mine
response: Do not open the package. Go to Your Orders → Problem with Order → Received someone else's package. Amazon will arrange for the correct package to be collected and your order resolved.

ticket: My Amazon music subscription is not working
response: Sign out of Amazon Music and sign back in. Clear the app cache or reinstall the app. Ensure your Prime or Amazon Music Unlimited subscription is active under Your Account → Prime Membership or Subscriptions.

ticket: How do I add an item to my Amazon wishlist
response: On any product page, click Add to Wish List and select the list to add it to. You can manage your wishlists under Accounts and Lists → Your Lists in the Amazon menu.

ticket: My Amazon seller account was suspended
response: Seller account suspensions require an appeal through Seller Central → Performance Notifications. Carefully review the suspension reason and submit a Plan of Action addressing each issue. We have escalated this for priority support.

ticket: I want to know how Amazon handles my personal data
response: Amazon's privacy policy is available at amazon.com/privacy. You can manage your data preferences under Your Account → Privacy Settings, including advertising preferences, Alexa history, and browsing data.

ticket: My Amazon Alexa is not responding
response: Check that Alexa is connected to Wi-Fi and the indicator ring is blue when you speak. Restart the device and check the Alexa app for any error notifications. Ensure the wake word detection is enabled.

ticket: I want to update my payment method on Amazon
response: Go to Your Account → Payment Settings → Manage Payment Methods. Add a new card or UPI ID and set it as default. Update existing orders to the new payment method if needed.

ticket: My Amazon order was delivered to a neighbor without my permission
response: Contact Amazon support and report that the package was left with a neighbor without authorization. If you cannot retrieve it, Amazon may issue a replacement or refund. We have flagged this for review.

ticket: Amazon rejected my return request
response: If your return was rejected, contact Amazon support to appeal the decision with your reason for return. Some items like digital content and perishables may be non-returnable per Amazon's policy.

ticket: My Amazon account shows orders I did not place
response: Unauthorized orders indicate account compromise. Change your password immediately and sign out of all devices under Your Account → Login and Security. Contact Amazon to report and reverse the unauthorized orders.

ticket: I want to know if Amazon delivered my package to a pickup point
response: If your package was delivered to a pickup point, you will receive an email notification with the location and pickup code. Go to the designated Amazon Hub Locker or pickup point within the specified timeframe to collect it.

ticket: I want a GST invoice for my Amazon order
response: To get a GST invoice, ensure your GST number is saved under Your Account → GST Number. After placing the order, go to Your Orders → Invoice to download the GST invoice. Not all sellers on Amazon are GST-registered.

ticket: My iPhone is not turning on
response: Connect your iPhone to a charger for at least 30 minutes. Then perform a force restart by pressing Volume Up, Volume Down, and holding the Side button until the Apple logo appears. If it still does not turn on, visit an Apple Store Genius Bar.

ticket: My Apple account was hacked
response: Go to appleid.apple.com immediately to change your password and enable two-factor authentication. Sign out of all devices under Settings → Your Name → Sign Out. Contact Apple Support to report unauthorized access.

ticket: I was charged for an App Store purchase I did not make
response: Go to reportaproblem.apple.com to request a refund for unauthorized purchases. Change your Apple ID password and enable two-factor authentication. We have escalated this as a high-priority fraud case.

ticket: My iPhone screen is cracked
response: Schedule a screen repair at an Apple Store or Apple Authorized Service Provider via getsupport.apple.com. Screen replacement is covered under AppleCare+ for a service fee. Out-of-warranty repairs are charged at standard rates.

ticket: My MacBook is not charging
response: Try a different charging cable and adapter. Check for debris in the USB-C port. Reset the SMC by shutting down, holding Shift+Control+Option+Power for 10 seconds, then powering on. Contact Apple Support if the issue persists.

ticket: My iPhone was stolen
response: This is a high-priority case. Immediately enable Lost Mode via Find My at findmy.apple.com to lock the device and display a contact message. Report the theft to local police and contact your carrier to block the SIM.

ticket: My iCloud storage is full
response: Go to Settings → Your Name → iCloud → Manage Storage to see what is using space. You can delete backups, photos, or purchase more iCloud storage starting at a low monthly fee. iCloud+ plans offer 50GB, 200GB, and 2TB options.

ticket: My Apple Watch is not syncing with my iPhone
response: Ensure Bluetooth is enabled on your iPhone and the Apple Watch is within range. Restart both devices. If syncing still fails, unpair and re-pair the Apple Watch through the Watch app on your iPhone.

ticket: I forgot my Apple ID password
response: Go to appleid.apple.com and click Forgot Apple ID or Password. Follow the steps to reset via trusted phone number, trusted device, or account recovery. Keep your recovery key if you have one enabled.

ticket: My AirPods are not connecting to my iPhone
response: Put AirPods in the case and close it for 30 seconds. Open the case near your iPhone and a connection prompt should appear. If not, go to Settings → Bluetooth and forget the AirPods, then re-pair from the case.

ticket: How do I cancel an Apple subscription
response: Go to Settings → Your Name → Subscriptions. Select the subscription you want to cancel and tap Cancel Subscription. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period.

ticket: My iPhone is running very slow
response: Free up storage by deleting unused apps and offloading large files. Go to Settings → General → iPhone Storage for recommendations. Also check for pending iOS updates and close background apps by swiping them away.

ticket: My MacBook keyboard is not working
response: Restart your MacBook first. If specific keys are unresponsive, there may be a hardware issue. MacBook keyboard repairs are covered under AppleCare+. Book a Genius Bar appointment at an Apple Store for diagnosis.

ticket: I cannot download apps from the App Store
response: Check your Apple ID payment method is valid under Settings → Your Name → Payment and Shipping. Ensure your iOS is up to date. If the issue persists, sign out of the App Store and sign back in.

ticket: My iPhone battery drains very fast
response: Go to Settings → Battery to see which apps use the most battery. Enable Low Power Mode under Settings → Battery. Consider replacing the battery if its maximum capacity is below 80% — check under Settings → Battery → Battery Health.

ticket: My iCloud photos are not syncing
response: Go to Settings → Your Name → iCloud → Photos and ensure iCloud Photos is enabled. Check that you have enough iCloud storage. Make sure your iPhone is connected to Wi-Fi for photo uploads.

ticket: My Apple Pay is not working
response: Ensure your card is properly added to Apple Pay under Settings → Wallet and Apple Pay. Check with your bank that they support Apple Pay. Also verify that NFC is enabled and your device is unlocked when tapping to pay.

ticket: My iPhone is stuck on the Apple logo
response: Force restart your iPhone. If it remains stuck, connect it to a Mac and use Finder to restore iOS. Note that restoration will erase your data — ensure you have a recent backup. Contact Apple Support if the issue persists.

ticket: I want to trade in my old iPhone
response: Visit apple.com/shop/trade-in to check your device's trade-in value. You can complete the trade-in online or at an Apple Store. The trade-in value is applied as credit toward a new Apple device.

ticket: My MacBook screen has dead pixels
response: Dead pixels may be covered under Apple's display quality program. Visit a Genius Bar for an assessment. If within warranty or AppleCare+, the display replacement may be covered at no additional cost.

ticket: How do I back up my iPhone
response: Back up your iPhone via iCloud by going to Settings → Your Name → iCloud → iCloud Backup → Back Up Now. Alternatively, connect to a Mac and use Finder to create a local backup for free.

ticket: My App Store purchase is not showing in my account
response: Go to Settings → Your Name → Media and Purchases → Purchase History to verify the transaction. If the purchase is confirmed but the app is not installing, go to the App Store and tap the cloud download icon next to the app.

ticket: My iPhone speaker is not working
response: Check that Do Not Disturb and Silent Mode are off. Go to Settings → Sounds and Haptics and adjust the volume. Test with headphones — if they work, the speaker may need repair. Book a Genius Bar appointment.

ticket: I want to restore my iPhone from a backup
response: During iPhone setup, choose Restore from iCloud Backup or Restore from Mac Backup. Alternatively, go to Settings → General → Transfer or Reset iPhone → Erase All Content and Settings to start fresh and restore from backup.

ticket: My MacBook is overheating
response: Ensure the MacBook vents are not blocked. Quit resource-intensive apps using Activity Monitor. Clean the fans if accessible. Update macOS to the latest version. If overheating persists, contact Apple Support for a hardware assessment.

ticket: I received a suspicious email claiming to be from Apple
response: Do not click any links or enter any credentials. Forward the email to reportphishing@apple.com. If you already clicked a link, change your Apple ID password immediately and enable two-factor authentication.

ticket: My iPhone is in recovery mode and I cannot exit
response: Connect your iPhone to a Mac and use Finder to update or restore it. Choose Update first to preserve data. If Update fails, Restore will erase and reinstall iOS. Ensure you have a recent backup before restoring.

ticket: My Apple TV is not connecting to my Wi-Fi
response: Go to Settings → Network on Apple TV and reconnect to your Wi-Fi network. Restart your router and Apple TV. If the issue persists, reset your Apple TV network settings under Settings → System → Reset → Reset Network Settings.

ticket: How do I enable two-factor authentication on my Apple ID
response: Go to Settings → Your Name → Password and Security → Two-Factor Authentication → Turn On. Follow the prompts to add a trusted phone number. Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security to your Apple ID.

ticket: My AirPods Pro noise cancellation is not working
response: Go to Settings → Bluetooth → AirPods Pro (i) → Noise Cancellation and ensure it is enabled. Clean the ear tips as debris can affect noise cancellation. Update AirPods firmware by keeping them in the case near a connected iPhone.

ticket: My iPhone microphone is not working during calls
response: Test the microphone by recording a voice memo. Check that the microphone is not blocked by a case. Go to Settings → Privacy → Microphone to ensure the Phone app has microphone access. Book a Genius Bar appointment if hardware-related.

ticket: My iPad is not connecting to Bluetooth devices
response: Toggle Bluetooth off and on in Settings. Forget the device and re-pair it. Restart your iPad. If the issue is with a specific accessory, check the accessory manufacturer's troubleshooting guide.

ticket: My Apple Watch keeps disconnecting from my iPhone
response: Keep your iPhone and Apple Watch within Bluetooth range. Restart both devices. Disable and re-enable Bluetooth on your iPhone. If the issue continues, unpair and re-pair the watch through the Apple Watch app.

ticket: My App Store is not loading
response: Check your internet connection. Sign out and back in to the App Store under Settings → Your Name → Sign Out. Clear the App Store cache by tapping the App Store tab 10 times rapidly. Update iOS if an update is pending.

ticket: I want to know if my Apple device is covered under warranty
response: Check your warranty status at checkcoverage.apple.com by entering your device serial number. The serial number is found under Settings → General → About. AppleCare+ extends coverage for up to 2 years with accidental damage protection.

ticket: My FaceTime calls keep dropping
response: Ensure a stable internet connection with at least 1 Mbps upload and download speed. Update iOS to the latest version. Sign out of FaceTime under Settings → FaceTime and sign back in. Restart your router if needed.

ticket: My iPhone is not receiving text messages
response: Check that your cellular plan is active and you have signal. Go to Settings → Messages and ensure Messages is enabled. Toggle Airplane Mode on and off. If still not receiving, contact your carrier to check if SMS is blocked.

ticket: My MacBook Touch ID is not working
response: Go to System Settings → Touch ID and Password and re-add your fingerprint. Clean the Touch ID sensor with a dry cloth. If it still fails, restart the MacBook. Persistent issues may require a Genius Bar assessment.

ticket: My iPhone is showing no SIM card
response: Remove the SIM tray, clean the SIM card, and reinsert it. Restart your iPhone. If the issue persists, try the SIM in another phone to check if the SIM is faulty. Contact your carrier or Apple Support if the issue continues.

ticket: I want to erase my iPhone before selling it
response: Before erasing, back up your data. Then go to Settings → General → Transfer or Reset iPhone → Erase All Content and Settings. Sign out of your Apple ID first under Settings → Your Name → Sign Out. This removes all personal data.

ticket: My code submission on HackerRank is failing all test cases
response: Review the problem's input/output format carefully — HackerRank requires reading from stdin and writing to stdout. Check your language version under the submission settings. Common issues include trailing spaces or wrong newline handling.

ticket: HackerRank IDE is very slow and keeps freezing
response: Try switching to a different browser or clearing your browser cache. Disable browser extensions that may interfere with the IDE. If the issue persists, copy your code to a local editor, write locally, and paste it back to submit.

ticket: My test cases pass locally but fail on HackerRank
response: Hidden test cases often include edge cases like empty input, maximum integer values, or very large datasets. Review the problem constraints and test your solution against boundary conditions before submitting.

ticket: I was flagged for plagiarism on HackerRank
response: HackerRank's automated plagiarism detection can sometimes flag similar solutions. You can appeal the decision by contacting HackerRank support at support.hackerrank.com with your submission details and explanation.

ticket: My HackerRank assessment link is not working
response: Check that the link has not expired — assessment links are time-bound. Ensure you are using the same email the link was sent to. Contact the recruiter or HackerRank support with the link URL and your account email.

ticket: I accidentally submitted the wrong solution on HackerRank
response: If the assessment is still open, you can resubmit. Go to the challenge and submit your corrected solution. If the assessment window has closed, contact the recruiter explaining the situation — they may be able to reopen it.

ticket: HackerRank is showing a compiler error for my code
response: Check that you selected the correct programming language and version in the submission dropdown. Verify that your code compiles correctly locally. Common issues include using language features not supported in the HackerRank environment.

ticket: My HackerRank score is not updating after submission
response: Leaderboard and score updates can take a few minutes after submission. Refresh the page after 5 minutes. If your score still does not update, contact HackerRank support with your submission ID and username.

ticket: I cannot access my HackerRank account
response: Try resetting your password via the Forgot Password link on the login page. If you cannot access your registered email, contact HackerRank support at support.hackerrank.com with your username and account details.

ticket: HackerRank is not compiling my Python code
response: Ensure you selected the correct Python version (Python 2 vs Python 3) in the submission settings. Check for syntax errors that may be version-specific. HackerRank supports Python 3.8 — avoid features from later versions.

ticket: My HackerRank contest submission was not recorded
response: This is a high-priority issue. Contact HackerRank support immediately with your submission timestamp, contest name, and username. Provide your code as evidence. We have escalated this for urgent review.

ticket: How do I improve my HackerRank problem-solving rank
response: Focus on completing challenges in Algorithms, Data Structures, and Problem Solving sections. Practice sorting, searching, dynamic programming, and graph problems. Consistent practice and participation in contests will improve your rating.

ticket: I received a wrong result for a correct solution on HackerRank
response: If you believe the expected output is wrong, use the Feedback or Report Issue option on the problem page. Provide your solution and the expected versus actual output. We have flagged this for review.

ticket: HackerRank keeps logging me out during an assessment
response: Session timeouts during assessments are a critical issue. Contact HackerRank support immediately with the assessment link and the time of logout. The recruiter should be notified to allow you to retake or extend the assessment.

ticket: My HackerRank certificate is not showing
response: Certificates are issued after completing a skill certification test with a qualifying score. Go to your HackerRank profile and check the Certificates section. If it is not showing after 24 hours, contact HackerRank support.

ticket: I want to know how HackerRank ranks are calculated
response: HackerRank ranks are based on your total score across all solved challenges. Each challenge awards points based on difficulty. Leaderboard rank reflects your score relative to other users in the same domain.

ticket: HackerRank is not accepting my input format
response: Review the problem statement for the exact input format. Many problems require specific whitespace, line break, or delimiter formats. Use the provided sample input to test your parsing logic before submitting.

ticket: My HackerRank profile badge is not updating
response: Badges update periodically after you reach a qualifying score threshold. Ensure you have completed enough challenges in the relevant domain. If it has not updated after 48 hours, contact HackerRank support.

ticket: I cannot see the test cases for a HackerRank problem
response: HackerRank only shows sample test cases publicly. Hidden test cases are used to prevent hardcoded solutions. Review the problem constraints and examples carefully to infer what the hidden cases might test.

ticket: My HackerRank submission timed out
response: Timeouts indicate your solution's time complexity is too high. Optimize your algorithm — if using O(n²) loops, consider hash maps or sorting-based O(n log n) approaches. Check the time limit specified in the problem.

ticket: HackerRank charged my card for a premium plan I did not sign up for
response: This is a high-priority billing issue. Contact HackerRank support at support.hackerrank.com immediately with your transaction ID. We have escalated this case for urgent review and refund processing.

ticket: I cannot find a specific problem on HackerRank
response: Use the search bar on the HackerRank Practice page and filter by domain, difficulty, or skill. If you are looking for a problem from a past contest, go to the Contests section and search by contest name.

ticket: My HackerRank environment is not supporting a specific library
response: HackerRank has a fixed set of pre-installed libraries per language. Check the problem's editorial or discussion section to see which libraries are supported. As an alternative, implement the required functionality manually.

ticket: I want to know how to read input in HackerRank
response: HackerRank requires reading from stdin. In Python, use input() or sys.stdin. In Java, use Scanner or BufferedReader. In C++, use cin or scanf. Always refer to the problem's input format section for the exact structure.

ticket: I got the correct answer but HackerRank marked it wrong
response: Check for trailing spaces, extra newlines, or incorrect data types in your output. If you are confident the answer is correct, use the Report Issue option on the problem page with your solution and output for review.

ticket: HackerRank is not loading my past submissions
response: Past submissions are accessible under the Submissions tab on each challenge page. If they are not loading, try a different browser or clear your cache. Contact HackerRank support if submissions are permanently missing.

ticket: I want to prepare for a HackerRank coding interview
response: Focus on HackerRank's Interview Preparation Kit which covers Arrays, Strings, Sorting, Trees, Graphs, and Dynamic Programming. Practice under timed conditions to simulate the actual interview environment.

ticket: My HackerRank test was auto-submitted before I finished
response: Auto-submission can occur when the assessment timer expires. Contact the recruiter immediately and explain the situation. Also contact HackerRank support with the assessment ID — they may be able to share the submission timestamp.

ticket: How do I use the HackerRank code editor effectively
response: The HackerRank editor supports themes, font size adjustment, and keyboard shortcuts. Use the Run Code button to test with custom input before submitting. You can also switch between languages using the dropdown menu.

ticket: I want to know if HackerRank monitors during assessments
response: HackerRank assessments can include proctoring features such as tab-switch detection, full-screen enforcement, and webcam monitoring depending on the company's settings. Follow the assessment instructions carefully to avoid flags.

ticket: I am getting a segmentation fault on HackerRank
response: Segmentation faults usually indicate out-of-bounds array access, null pointer dereference, or stack overflow due to deep recursion. Review your array indexing and recursion depth. Test with boundary inputs locally.

ticket: My HackerRank assessment invitation expired
response: Contact the recruiter who sent you the assessment link and request a new invitation. Assessment links typically expire after a set period. We have flagged this for follow-up support.

ticket: I want to practice SQL on HackerRank
response: Go to HackerRank Practice → Databases → SQL. Problems range from basic SELECT queries to advanced window functions and joins. The SQL editor allows you to run queries against a sample database before submitting.

ticket: HackerRank is not recognizing my correct output
response: Check if your output has any extra spaces, missing newlines, or character encoding issues. HackerRank does exact string matching on output. Even a single extra space can cause a wrong answer verdict.

ticket: I want to download my HackerRank submissions
response: HackerRank does not provide a bulk download option for submissions. You can view individual submissions under the challenge's Submissions tab and manually copy your code. Consider maintaining your solutions in a personal GitHub repository.

ticket: My HackerRank rank dropped after a contest
response: Contest rankings are recalculated after the contest ends based on the full set of submissions and participants. Rank changes are normal. Focus on improving your solutions and participating in more contests to improve your standing.

ticket: I want to know the passing score for HackerRank certification
response: HackerRank skill certifications require a minimum score of 50-60% depending on the certification type. Scores above 70% are typically considered advanced. Check the certification page for the specific passing criteria.

ticket: HackerRank is giving me a wrong answer on the last test case
response: The last test case is often the largest or most complex edge case. Common failures involve integer overflow, memory limit exceeded, or incorrect handling of zero or negative values. Review your logic for extreme input sizes.

ticket: My HackerRank account was banned
response: Account bans are issued for violations of HackerRank's Terms of Service including plagiarism and cheating. Contact HackerRank support at support.hackerrank.com to appeal the ban with supporting evidence. We have escalated this case.

ticket: I cannot submit more than once on a HackerRank challenge
response: Some challenges and assessments restrict multiple submissions. Practice challenges typically allow unlimited retries. If you are in an assessment, check the rules for the number of allowed attempts. Contact the recruiter if you need an additional attempt.

ticket: My Claude API key is not working
response: Verify that your API key starts with sk-ant and is correctly set in the x-api-key header. Regenerate a new key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys if needed. Ensure the key has not been revoked or rate-limited.

ticket: I am getting a 401 error on the Claude API
response: A 401 error means your API key is invalid or missing. Confirm the key is correctly set in the Authorization or x-api-key header. Generate a new key at console.anthropic.com if the current one is not working.

ticket: Claude API is returning a 429 rate limit error
response: You have exceeded your rate limit. Wait for the rate limit window to reset — typically one minute. To avoid this, implement exponential backoff in your retry logic. You can apply for a higher rate limit tier at console.anthropic.com.

ticket: I am being charged more than expected on Claude API
response: Go to console.anthropic.com → Usage to see a breakdown of your token consumption by model and date. Input and output tokens are billed separately. Consider using prompt caching to reduce costs by up to 90% for repeated prompts.

ticket: Claude is not following my system prompt
response: Ensure the system prompt is passed in the system field, not in the user messages array. The system prompt sets the AI's behavior for the entire conversation. Make your instructions explicit and specific to get consistent results.

ticket: Claude API is giving inconsistent responses
response: Inconsistent responses can be reduced by lowering the temperature parameter (0.0-0.3 for deterministic output). Also set a fixed seed if your SDK supports it. Use explicit, detailed prompts to reduce ambiguity in the model's interpretation.

ticket: How do I use function calling in the Claude API
response: Pass your function definitions in the tools parameter of the API request as a structured array. Claude will return a tool_use block when it wants to call a function. Process the tool result and pass it back in a tool_result block.

ticket: Claude is generating harmful content in my application
response: This is a high-priority safety case. Review and strengthen your system prompt to explicitly prohibit harmful output. Contact Anthropic support at support.anthropic.com with examples of the harmful output for review.

ticket: My Claude API request is timing out
response: Complex prompts can take 30-60 seconds to complete. Increase your HTTP client timeout setting. Use streaming (stream: true) to receive partial responses as they generate, which prevents client-side timeout on long responses.

ticket: I want to know Claude API pricing
response: Claude API pricing is based on tokens consumed. Check the latest pricing at anthropic.com/api for input and output token rates by model. Claude Haiku is the most cost-effective, while Claude Opus offers the most capability.

ticket: How do I enable streaming on the Claude API
response: Set stream: true in your API request body. Your client will then receive server-sent events with each token as it is generated. Use an SSE-compatible HTTP client to handle the streaming response correctly.

ticket: I want to reduce my Claude API costs
response: Use prompt caching for repeated system prompts — it can reduce costs by up to 90%. Use Claude Haiku for classification and simple tasks, reserving Sonnet or Opus for complex reasoning. Set appropriate max_tokens limits.

ticket: Claude is not remembering previous messages in my app
response: Claude has no built-in memory between API calls. You must include the full conversation history in each request's messages array. Implement your own conversation management system to maintain context across turns.

ticket: My Claude API account was suspended
response: Account suspensions are issued for violations of Anthropic's usage policy. Contact Anthropic support at support.anthropic.com with your account details and usage context to appeal the suspension. We have escalated this.

ticket: How do I count tokens in a Claude API request
response: Use the Anthropic tokenizer library or the API's token counting endpoint to estimate tokens before sending a request. This helps you manage context window usage and optimize costs by trimming unnecessary context.

ticket: Claude API is returning an empty response
response: Empty responses can occur due to content filtering triggering a stop, max_tokens set too low, or a network issue. Check the stop_reason field in the response. Increase max_tokens if the response is being cut short.

ticket: I want to use Claude for my enterprise application
response: Contact Anthropic's sales team at anthropic.com/contact-sales for enterprise pricing, SLAs, dedicated capacity, and compliance information. Enterprise plans offer higher rate limits and custom agreements.

ticket: Claude is refusing to answer questions it should be able to answer
response: Claude's safety guidelines may be triggering on certain topics. Review your system prompt to ensure you are not inadvertently restricting Claude's behavior. You can also adjust the prompt framing to make the request clearer and more specific.

ticket: My Claude API free credits have run out
response: Free trial credits are a one-time allocation for new accounts. After they are exhausted, add a payment method at console.anthropic.com → Billing to continue using the API. Set a usage limit to control your monthly spend.

ticket: How do I switch from Claude Sonnet to Claude Haiku in my API calls
response: Change the model field in your API request from claude-sonnet-4-6 to claude-haiku-4-5-20251001. Haiku is faster and cheaper, ideal for classification, extraction, and simpler tasks. Test thoroughly after switching to ensure output quality meets your needs.

ticket: Claude API is not working with my Python SDK
response: Ensure you have the latest version of the Anthropic Python SDK installed: pip install anthropic --upgrade. Check that your API key is correctly set via the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable or passed directly to the Anthropic client.

ticket: How do I implement prompt caching in the Claude API
response: Add a cache_control block with type: ephemeral to the content you want to cache, typically your system prompt or large reference documents. Cached content is stored for up to 5 minutes and reused across calls, significantly reducing input token costs.

ticket: I want to build a RAG system using Claude API
response: Retrieve relevant documents from your vector database, include them in the user message as context, and instruct Claude to answer based only on the provided context. Use prompt caching for large static knowledge bases to reduce costs.

ticket: Claude is producing hallucinated information in my application
response: Reduce hallucinations by providing explicit reference documents in the prompt and instructing Claude to only answer from the provided context. Use a lower temperature setting. For factual applications, always implement a verification step.

ticket: How do I set a spending limit on my Claude API account
response: Go to console.anthropic.com → Billing → Usage Limits and set a monthly spending cap. You will receive an email notification when you approach the limit. The API will stop processing requests once the limit is reached.

ticket: Claude API is down or not responding
response: Check the Anthropic status page at status.anthropic.com for any ongoing incidents. If there is no reported outage and the issue persists, contact Anthropic support with your request details and error messages.

ticket: I want to analyze images with the Claude API
response: Claude's vision capability allows image analysis. Pass images as base64-encoded content in the messages array with type: image and source.type: base64. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, GIF, and WebP.

ticket: How do I get a Claude API key
response: Sign up at console.anthropic.com and navigate to API Keys → Create New Key. Store the key securely as it will only be shown once. Set it as the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable in your application.

ticket: I want to know Claude's context window size
response: Claude's context window varies by model. Claude Haiku supports 200K tokens, Claude Sonnet supports 200K tokens, and Claude Opus supports 200K tokens. The context window includes both input (prompt + history) and output tokens.

ticket: My Claude API batch processing job failed
response: Check the batch job status at console.anthropic.com → Batch API. Failed jobs include error details in the results file. Common causes include malformed requests or rate limit exceeded. Retry failed requests individually to isolate the issue.

ticket: How do I migrate from GPT to Claude API
response: The Claude API uses a similar messages format to OpenAI. Key differences: use x-api-key instead of Authorization: Bearer, the system prompt goes in a system field (not as a system role message), and response content is in content[0].text.

ticket: I want to fine-tune Claude for my use case
response: Anthropic does not currently offer public fine-tuning for Claude. Instead, use few-shot prompting with examples in your system prompt or messages to guide Claude's behavior. Contact Anthropic sales for enterprise custom model options.

ticket: Claude is generating very long responses when I need short ones
response: Add explicit length instructions to your system prompt such as 'Respond in 2-3 sentences only' or 'Be concise and direct'. You can also set max_tokens to limit response length. Providing an example of the desired response format also helps.

ticket: I want to use Claude API in my Node.js application
response: Install the Anthropic Node.js SDK: npm install @anthropic-ai/sdk. Import and initialize with your API key: const client = new Anthropic(). Use client.messages.create() with your model, max_tokens, and messages parameters.

ticket: How do I handle Claude API errors in my application
response: Wrap API calls in try-catch blocks. Handle 401 (invalid key), 429 (rate limit — implement exponential backoff), 500 (server error — retry after delay), and 529 (overloaded — retry with backoff). Log the error type and request ID for debugging.

ticket: My Netflix account was hacked
response: Go to Account → Security → Sign out of all devices immediately and change your password. Enable two-factor authentication. Contact Netflix support to report unauthorized access. We have escalated this as a high-priority case.

ticket: I was charged for Netflix after cancelling
response: Contact Netflix support with your cancellation confirmation date. If cancelled before the renewal date, Netflix will issue a refund. We have flagged this for priority review and refund processing.

ticket: Netflix is not playing videos on my TV
response: Restart your TV and the Netflix app. Check your internet speed — Netflix requires at least 5 Mbps for HD streaming. Sign out and back in to your Netflix account. Update the Netflix app if an update is pending.

ticket: Netflix keeps buffering
response: Slow buffering is usually caused by a slow internet connection. Run a speed test and ensure you have at least 5 Mbps for HD. Switch to a lower video quality under Account → Playback Settings. Restart your router if needed.

ticket: I cannot download Netflix content for offline viewing
response: Downloads require a Netflix Standard or Premium plan — the Basic with Ads plan does not support downloads. Ensure you have sufficient device storage. Titles must be available for download in your region.

ticket: Netflix charged me in the wrong currency
response: Netflix charges in the currency of the country associated with your payment method. If the currency is incorrect, update your payment method to a local card or UPI. Contact Netflix support for a billing adjustment.

ticket: My Netflix subscription auto-renewed and I want a refund
response: Contact Netflix support within 7 days of the renewal charge. Refunds are assessed case by case. Go to netflix.com/contact-us for live chat support. We have flagged this for priority review.

ticket: I cannot add a Netflix profile
response: The number of profiles depends on your plan — Basic supports 1, Standard supports 2, and Premium supports 4. If you have reached your limit, you must delete an existing profile to add a new one.

ticket: Netflix shows are not available in my region
response: Netflix content varies by region due to licensing agreements. Using a VPN to access content from other regions violates Netflix's Terms of Service. Content libraries are regularly updated — check back as new titles are added.

ticket: My Netflix payment failed
response: Update your payment method under Account → Manage Payment Info. Ensure your card details are correct and the card has not expired. Netflix will retry the payment automatically — you can also retry manually from your account page.

ticket: How do I link my Visa card to PhonePe
response: Open PhonePe, go to My Money → Bank Accounts → Add Bank Account. Select your bank and link your Visa debit card using your registered mobile number and debit card details for UPI payments.

ticket: My Visa card is not working on PhonePe
response: Ensure your card is linked correctly under My Money in PhonePe. Check that the mobile number registered with your bank matches your PhonePe number. Contact your bank to confirm online and UPI transactions are enabled.

ticket: I want to block my Visa card immediately
response: Block your card immediately through your bank's mobile app under Card Settings → Block Card, or call your bank's 24/7 helpline. We have escalated this as a high-priority case. Your bank will issue a replacement within 5-10 business days.

ticket: How do I add my Visa card to Paytm
response: Open Paytm, go to Passbook → Add Money → Add a Debit/Credit Card. Enter your Visa card number, expiry date, and CVV. Complete the OTP verification sent to your registered mobile number.

ticket: My Visa card transaction is showing as pending for a week
response: Pending transactions older than 7 days should have settled. Contact your bank with the transaction ID to request it be settled or released. We have flagged this for follow-up.

ticket: I want to apply for a Visa credit card
response: Visit your preferred bank's website or nearest branch to apply for a Visa credit card. Eligibility is based on your income, credit score, and employment status. The approval process typically takes 7-14 business days.

ticket: I received a call asking for my Visa card OTP — is it genuine
response: Never share your OTP with anyone — not even bank representatives. This is a phishing scam. Hang up immediately. Contact your bank to report the attempt and verify your account security. We have escalated this case.

ticket: My Visa card cashback is not credited
response: Cashback is credited based on your card's reward program terms — typically within 30-90 days after the qualifying transaction. Check your bank's rewards portal for the credit timeline. Contact your bank if it is overdue.

ticket: I want to know my Visa card bill due date
response: Your bill due date is shown in your monthly credit card statement and in your bank's mobile app under Credit Card → Statement. Set up autopay to avoid late payment fees.

ticket: My Visa card was cloned at an ATM
response: This is a critical fraud case. Block your card immediately and file a fraud report with your bank. Report the ATM to the bank that operates it. Your bank will reverse unauthorized transactions under Visa Zero Liability.

ticket: Amazon delivery is a day late
response: Minor delivery delays can occur due to logistics. Check your tracking link for the latest update. If the new estimated delivery date passes without delivery, go to Your Orders → Problem with Order → Package didn't arrive.

ticket: I want to know Amazon's refund timeline
response: Amazon refunds are processed within 3-5 business days after the return is received. Refunds to credit/debit cards take an additional 2-3 business days to reflect. Instant refunds are available for Amazon Pay balance.

ticket: My Amazon order shows two shipments but I only received one
response: Check Your Orders for both shipment tracking details. Report the missing shipment under Problem with Order → Missing items. We have flagged this for follow-up to ensure the second shipment is traced or replaced.

ticket: I want to know if an Amazon product is genuine
response: Look for the Sold by Amazon label or the Fulfilled by Amazon badge on the product page. Check seller ratings and reviews. For branded electronics, verify the product on the brand's official website using the serial number.

ticket: My Amazon account shows a different shipping address
response: An unauthorized address change indicates possible account compromise. Change your password and review all recent orders immediately. Contact Amazon support to secure your account. We have escalated this as a high-priority security case.

ticket: I want to gift an Amazon order to someone
response: During checkout, select the delivery address of the recipient and check the option to add a gift message. Choose gift wrapping if available. The price will not be shown on the packing slip for gift orders.

ticket: Amazon Prime is not giving me free delivery
response: Ensure your Prime membership is active under Your Account → Prime Membership. Free delivery applies to Prime-eligible items — look for the Prime badge on the product page. Some sellers may not offer Prime delivery.

ticket: I received an Amazon order without an invoice
response: Most Amazon orders include a packing slip. For a full invoice, go to Your Orders → Invoice for each order. If you need a GST invoice, ensure your GST number is saved in your account under Account → GST Number.

ticket: My Amazon Pay balance is missing
response: Go to Your Account → Amazon Pay → Balance to check your transaction history. If the balance is missing, contact Amazon support with a screenshot of the previous balance. We have flagged this for review.

ticket: I want to know how to use Amazon Pay Later
response: Amazon Pay Later allows you to make purchases and pay within 30 days or in EMIs. It is available on eligible accounts. Go to Amazon Pay → Amazon Pay Later to check eligibility and activate it if available.

ticket: My iPhone notch camera has a green dot showing unexpectedly
response: A green dot indicates an app is using your camera. Check which app by swiping down the Control Centre — it shows the last app to use the camera. If it is an unrecognized app, revoke its camera access under Settings → Privacy → Camera.

ticket: How do I transfer data from Android to iPhone
response: During iPhone setup, use the Move to iOS app on your Android phone to wirelessly transfer contacts, messages, photos, and app data. Connect both phones to the same Wi-Fi network and follow the on-screen instructions.

ticket: My Apple ID is locked
response: Go to appleid.apple.com and follow the steps to unlock your Apple ID. You may need to verify your identity using your trusted phone number or answer security questions. Contact Apple Support if you cannot unlock it online.

ticket: My iPhone hotspot is not working
response: Go to Settings → Personal Hotspot and ensure it is enabled. Check that your carrier plan includes hotspot functionality. Toggle Airplane Mode on and off. Restart your iPhone. Contact your carrier if hotspot is not included in your plan.

ticket: I accidentally deleted important photos from my iPhone
response: Go to Photos → Albums → Recently Deleted — photos are kept for 30 days before permanent deletion. Restore them from there. If they have been permanently deleted, check your iCloud backup under Settings → Your Name → iCloud → Manage Storage.

ticket: My Face ID is not working on iPhone
response: Go to Settings → Face ID and Passcode and reset Face ID by deleting and re-adding your face. Ensure your face is not obstructed and the TrueDepth camera is clean. If Face ID still fails, contact Apple Support for a hardware assessment.

ticket: My iPhone is not connecting to Wi-Fi
response: Forget the network under Settings → Wi-Fi → (Network Name) → Forget and reconnect. Reset network settings under Settings → General → Transfer or Reset → Reset Network Settings. This will also reset Bluetooth and VPN settings.

ticket: My Apple TV remote is not working
response: Charge the Siri Remote using a USB-C or Lightning cable. Hold the Back and Volume Down buttons for 5 seconds to reset the remote. If it still does not work, go to Apple TV Settings → Remotes and Devices → Bluetooth to reconnect.

ticket: I want to know how to use Screen Time on iPhone
response: Go to Settings → Screen Time to set daily app limits, downtime schedules, and content restrictions. Use a Screen Time passcode to prevent children from changing the settings. Reports show daily and weekly usage by app category.

ticket: My iPhone is showing low storage even after deleting apps
response: Other data such as cached files, offline maps, and message attachments can consume significant storage. Go to Settings → General → iPhone Storage for storage recommendations. Offloading unused apps retains the app's documents and data.

ticket: I want to know how HackerRank proctoring works
response: HackerRank proctoring can include tab-switch detection, webcam snapshots, and full-screen enforcement. These features are configured by the company administering the test. Follow the assessment instructions carefully to avoid unintentional flags.

ticket: My HackerRank IDE is showing a syntax error for valid code
response: Ensure the correct language version is selected in the submission dropdown. Different versions support different syntax — for example Python 3.8 does not support all Python 3.10 features. Test your code locally first.

ticket: How do I practice system design on HackerRank
response: HackerRank focuses primarily on coding challenges. For system design practice, use the Interview Preparation Kit's Problem Solving section. Supplement with resources like system design primers on GitHub or dedicated platforms.

ticket: I want to know HackerRank's difficulty levels
response: HackerRank categorizes challenges into Easy, Medium, Hard, and Expert levels. Easy problems typically involve basic data structures, while Expert problems require advanced algorithms like segment trees or suffix arrays.

ticket: My HackerRank code is giving the right answer but exceeding memory limit
response: Memory limit exceeded errors occur when your solution uses too much RAM. Optimize by using in-place algorithms, avoiding unnecessary copies of large data structures, and using generators instead of lists where possible.

ticket: Can I use external libraries in HackerRank submissions
response: HackerRank provides a fixed set of pre-installed libraries. You cannot install external packages. Check the problem's environment details or editorial to see what is available. Popular libraries like NumPy and collections are usually pre-installed.

ticket: I want to know my HackerRank percentile score
response: Your HackerRank percentile is shown on your profile under each domain such as Problem Solving or SQL. It represents your performance relative to all users who have attempted the same challenges in that domain.

ticket: HackerRank is showing a different score than I expected
response: Scores are based on the percentage of test cases passed and the difficulty of the problem. Partial scoring awards points for each passing test case. Review the problem's scoring section to understand how points are allocated.

ticket: I want to know if HackerRank certifications are recognized by employers
response: HackerRank certifications are recognized by many technology companies and can be shared on your LinkedIn profile. They validate specific technical skills like Problem Solving, SQL, Python, and Java to a recognized industry standard.

ticket: My HackerRank contest ended while I was mid-submission
response: Contact HackerRank support at support.hackerrank.com immediately with your submission timestamp, contest name, and code. We have escalated this as a high-priority case for the contest administration team to review.

ticket: I want to use Claude for content moderation
response: Claude can be used for content moderation by providing clear guidelines in the system prompt about what constitutes violating content. Use structured output to get consistent classification results. Test extensively with diverse edge cases before deployment.

ticket: How do I pass conversation history to Claude API
response: Include the full conversation history in the messages array with alternating user and assistant roles. Claude has no built-in memory between API calls — you must send the complete conversation context in each request.

ticket: Claude API is returning truncated responses
response: Increase the max_tokens parameter in your API request. Claude stops generating when it reaches the max_tokens limit. For long documents or detailed responses, set max_tokens to 4096 or higher depending on your use case.

ticket: I want to use Claude for PDF analysis
response: Pass PDF content as base64-encoded data in the messages array using the document content type. Claude can analyze, summarize, and answer questions about PDF documents within its context window limit.

ticket: How do I get Claude to respond in JSON format
response: Include explicit instructions in your system prompt: 'Respond only in valid JSON format with no markdown or explanation.' For structured outputs, provide an example JSON schema. Claude will follow the format consistently when instructed clearly.

ticket: I want to use Claude API for my chatbot
response: Use the messages API with a strong system prompt defining your chatbot's persona and constraints. Maintain conversation history in your application and pass it with each API call. Use streaming for a responsive chat experience.

ticket: My Claude API responses are not in the language I requested
response: Specify the language requirement explicitly in your system prompt: 'Always respond in Hindi' or 'Respond in the same language as the user.' Claude can handle multilingual conversations when clearly instructed.

ticket: I want to know Claude's safety policies
response: Claude's usage policies are available at anthropic.com/usage-policy. Claude refuses to generate content that is harmful, illegal, or violates its guidelines. Contact Anthropic support if you believe a refusal was incorrect for your legitimate use case.

ticket: How do I use Claude API for document summarization
response: Pass the document text in the user message and instruct Claude to summarize it. For very long documents, split them into sections and summarize each section, then ask Claude to combine the summaries. Use prompt caching for repeated documents.

ticket: Claude API is generating content that violates my platform guidelines
response: Strengthen your system prompt with explicit restrictions and examples of prohibited content. Implement a secondary content filter in your application. Contact Anthropic support with examples of the violating content for guidance on prompt engineering.

ticket: Netflix is showing someone else's watch history
